[[File:Baralousealife.jpg|thumb|Coral on Baralou]]
{{Quote|A pity, though, to have to damage any of these reefs. They're genuine works of art. Unique, perhaps, in that they were created by living yet nonsentient beings. I should have liked to have studied them more closely.|[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
'''Coral''' was a type of [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] animal found on [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]], [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]], [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], [[Drexel/Legends|Drexel]], [[Baralou]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and other [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] built beautiful cities with towers and spires among the coral reefs of their home planet Dac.<ref name="SWE Mon Calamari">{{SWE|groups|moncalamari|Mon Calamari}}</ref> Coral was not just limited to aquatic life, however, an example being the [[Rugosa land coral|land coral]] of Rugosa.
